name: To See Another Day
source: You open your eyes to find a broken and abandoned  world without any memory of who you are or how you got there, you must learn to adapt quickly alongside your new companion Ophelia who isn’t quite so human herself anymore.  Craft, fight, and romance  your way through a city while you try to uncover the secret of what brought you to this world and who is responsible for it descending into a state of Delirium.
